name: week
title: Pay reviews this week
subtitle: Private planning snapshot. Not a payroll instruction.

sections.title: Work needing attention
sections.sql: select cycle,employee_code,name,manager,status,reason,due_on from attention_queue order by due_on,employee_code

sections.title: Manager submissions
sections.sql: select cycle,manager,status,count(*) records from proposal_register group by cycle,manager,status order by cycle,manager,status

sections.title: Separate budgets by currency and department
sections.sql: select * from budget_summary order by cycle,department
sections.note: Annual recurring increases and one-off bonuses are never added to one budget. No currency conversion.

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select cycle,employee_code,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by cycle,employee_code

sections.title: Approved changes awaiting agreement
sections.sql: select cycle,employee_code,name,currency,proposed_cents,effective_on from proposal_register where status='approved' and agreement_ref is null
